name: Fuel Run
design_intent:
TUTORIAL 4 of 4. Lesson: PADS REFILL THE TANK — recharge along the way. A tank_run-shaped A->B crossing over a lethal void, tuned so ONE tank cannot fly the whole span: total crossing ~3600px of powered flight > 2660px (one full tank), so the player MUST touch the stepping pads (+20 fuel per bounce, fuel_per_bounce) to bank range — the exact recharge loop the whole game economy runs on. Four 700px gaps: 700 > 527 (max zero-boost spring drift) and > 395 (trampoline drift), so every gap is flight-required (a bounce alone falls in). Per-leg cost ~700px at 760 px/s ~= 0.95s ~= 27 fuel vs +20 refund per pad touch plus the double-bounce trick (bounce the same pad twice to bank +40) — the course closes comfortably for a player who touches pads and starves a player who tries to skip them, which IS the lesson. First tutorial with a real void: falls are free respawns at the start gate (v10), introducing death-space safely.

WK-123 (2026-11-14, CD2 accept 'FLY-only fails tut_04'): after WK-95 (cap 800, grip, ~2800 px level range per tank) a FLY-only pilot that flew OVER every pad fell only ~15 px short of the goal pad with Ziggy (boost 1.08). Every gap is now +75 px (pads x1095/2020/2945, goal pad x3870-4230, goal x4050, void +300). MEASURED in-engine: no-touch FLY-only falls short by ~380 px (Standard/Puff) and ~180 px (Ziggy); touching the three pads clears with 24-25 fuel left (Standard/Puff). The 760 px/s figures above are pre-WK-95.
hint: PADS REFILL YOUR TANK — TOUCH EVERY ONE
